Order No.04 / Dated : 25.03.2026 I.A. No. 60 of 2026 Heard Mr. Ashish Gautam, learned counsel for the appellant and learned Special P.P.
This interlocutory application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
The appellant has been convicted for the offences under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for ten years along with a fine of Rs. 20,000/-.
It has been alleged that the informant had developed relationship with the appellant and the appellant on the pretext of marriage, had established physical relationship with her on several occasions.

It appears from the evidence of the victim, who has been examined as P.W. 1 that the relationship continued for three years and in her cross-examination, she has categorically stated that since there was an opposition from the parents of the appellant to solemnize the marriage of the appellant with the victim, she has instituted the case.
On consideration of the aforesaid fact, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

Accordingly,
during the pendency of this appeal, the appellant is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Nagar Untari, Garhwa in connection with S.T.
No.423 of 2022 arising out of Ramna P.S. Case No.61 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No.64 of 2022.
